subject: Greenline: Admin activity proofs — on-demand vs batch export options
messages:
From: Alice Greenline <alice@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Admin activity evidence for SOC 2 — Greenline request

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick sync today. For our upcoming SOC 2 Type II audit we need an evidence package showing admin activity and operator actions for the period 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31. High level ask: what exact events you capture, retention windows, and the export options (on-demand snapshot vs recurring/batch deliverables).

Priority items for auditor:
- All privileged administrative actions (user create/delete, role changes, permission grants)
- API key lifecycle events (create, revoke, rotate) and which service principal performed them
- Console sign-ins with IP, MFA status, and session id
- Model deployment events (version pinning/rollouts, canary failures)
- Admin console configuration changes (routing policies, retention settings)

Can you point us at a preferred delivery method and an estimate for turnaround if we request a full tenant snapshot (signed, HMAC manifest, encrypted at rest)? I've attached a brief spec with preferred columns.

Best,
Alice Greenline
Director, Security & Compliance
Greenline Health

---
Attachment: greenline_export_spec_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Greenline <alice@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC 2 — Greenline request

Alice — thanks, and appreciate the spec. Summary of what we can provide and options: 

What we log (full list):
- Admin user actions: create/update/delete user, role assignment, permission grants/revokes, invited users.
- Authentication events: console sign-in success/failure, SSO provider assertions, MFA challenge & result.
- API & agent events: API key create/revoke/rotate, service principal token issues, token introspection failures.
- Operational actions: model deploy, rollback, configuration change to routing/batching/quantization profiles.
- Resource lifecycle: GPU pool allocation, node drain/reschedule, infra scale events (autoscaler decisions).
- Audit metadata: event_id, timestamp (UTC), actor_principal, actor_email, actor_ip, user_agent, request_path, request_params (snipped), outcome, request_id, correlated_session_id, kv_cache_snapshot_ref (if applicable).

Retention & redaction:
- Default retention for admin activity: 5 years (configurable per-customer).
- Shorter operational logs (debug/trace) retained 90 days unless flagged for retention.
- PII in request_params is redacted by default; we can provide a scrubbed and an unredacted export under an MSA/NDA with approved access controls.

Export options (we support both):
1) On-demand tenant snapshot (recommended for audits) — produced as a timeboxed tar.gz of newline-delimited JSON (jsonl) per topic, AES-256 encrypt, HMAC manifest + SHA256 checksums, and a signed timestamp. Delivery via pre-signed S3 URL or secure SFTP. Typical turnaround: 48-72 business hours for full snapshot.
2) Recurring batch exports — daily or weekly delta packages pushed to your S3 bucket or our secure Transfer. Packages include manifest, incremental IDs, and replay tokens.
3) Streaming audit feed — if you need near-real-time ingestion into your SIEM, we can stream via a durable Kafka topic or provide a Firehose connector (requires integration engineering and a short onboarding).

I'll loop in ops to confirm lead times. If you want an immediate sample, I can send a 7-day jsonl sample with our manifest and HMAC.

—Logan
Director, Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: admin_activity_sample_snippet.jsonl (jsonl)

From: Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@cloudpartner.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>; Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Greenline <alice@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC 2 — Greenline request

Adding a couple of integration constraints from our side (CloudPartner):
- Greenline needs exported timestamps normalized to UTC and annotated with original tz for forensic correlation.
- We prefer manifest-level HMAC using a customer-supplied key (KMS/HSM bring-your-own-key). Is that supported?
- For chain-of-custody we need a signed manifest (sha256) and optionally a notarized time-stamp.

If Redwood can do BYOK for manifest HMAC and provide the signed manifest file, Greenline's legal will be satisfied.

Thanks,
Tim
Solutions Architect, CloudPartner

---
(Forwarded message header preserved when we include sample packages.)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Greenline <alice@greenlinehealth.com>, Tim Jenkins <tim.jenkins@cloudpartner.io>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC 2 — Greenline request

Logged a few implementation notes from infra/ops:
- BYOK for manifest HMAC: supported. We can accept a public key/cert for manifest signing or an ARN for KMS where we create and use a dedicated key for the export job.
- Turnaround: full tenant 48-72 business hours; delta exports (7 day) within 8-12 business hours.
- Export format: jsonl per topic (admin_activity.jsonl, auth_events.jsonl, model_changes.jsonl). Each file includes header rows with schema version, UTC snapshot timestamp, and field-level redaction flags.
- We will include a machine-readable manifest (manifest.json) plus signed_manifest.sha256 and an HMAC over the manifest using the BYOK material.
- For very large tenants we offer chunked archives with per-chunk checksums and a top-level manifest to speed verification.

Operational caveats:
- Some debug-level request_params are stored in a bounded buffer for 90 days; those are intentionally excluded from tenant snapshots unless explicitly requested and approved.
- Cross-region exports require an additional attestation; we can provide it but need signed exec approval to move logs across EU/US boundaries (not an issue for Greenline in US).

I'll prepare a reproducible checklist and our SRE contact for a dry-run.

—Rishi
Sr. Product Manager, Infra Logs
Redwood Inference

Attachment: signed_manifest.sha256 (sha256)

From: Alice Greenline <alice@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Admin activity evidence for SOC 2 — Greenline request

Thanks everyone — this is helpful and addresses most of our asks. Quick decisions from Greenline legal/audit:
- We will request an on-demand full tenant snapshot (jsonl, encrypted) with BYOK HMAC on the manifest.
- Please schedule a dry-run on Nov 24 to validate schema and checksum verification steps; Greenline will provide a temporary S3 bucket and KMS key for the handoff.
- We also want a daily delta feed to our SIEM for the audit period (Jan–Oct) while the PTO is finalized; Tim will coordinate the SIEM ingest.

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Confirm dry-run slot and SRE contact.
2) Provide the export checklist and an example verification script (sha256 check + HMAC verification).
3) Share sample 7-day jsonl (already referenced).

Appreciate the clarity — looping in Marissa for contract/ops alignment on the access window and acceptance criteria.

Best,
Alice
Director, Security & Compliance
Greenline Health
